chapter: Blanton, Los Angeles and Art Tatum
title: A week with Coleman Hawkins and Roy Eldridge in Providence
summary: Around 1949, while still with Tatum, Stewart did a week with Hawkins and Eldridge in a Providence club.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: -- you know, when you started playing those diminished chords, that he was one of the first guys that, although now, another guy I wanted to ask you about, did you work with -- did you work with Coleman Hawkins any during those years?

Yes. I think that came a little later, though. I'd say about in the late '40s. I did a gig with Coleman Hawkins in Providence, Rhode Island. He and the trumpet player, Roy Eldridge and a pianist, and (inaudible) Drummer, we worked at a little club in Providence. It was back in the late '40s, I think, around '49, something like that. And that was a nice experience. I wasn't -- I was still with Tatum, but I did this one week with Coleman Hawkins and Roy in this club in Providence.
